name: Growth OS — 1. Enroll prospects into the email sequence

nodes.name: Every working day 09:00 Dhaka
nodes.notes: 03:00 UTC = 09:00 Asia/Dhaka. Sun-Thu only: Fri/Sat is the Bangladesh weekend and cold email lands dead.

parameters.query:
-- Enroll the next batch of contactable prospects.
-- LIMIT is the warm-up throttle: raise it only on the schedule in dns-and-warmup.md.
-- Never enrol a prospect twice (unique constraint on prospect_id+sequence_id) and never
-- enrol one who already replied, opted out, or is already in a deal.
with seq as (
  select id from public.sequences where name = 'Cold Email — BD Hotels v1' and is_active limit 1
),
picked as (
  select p.id
    from public.prospects p, seq
   where p.email is not null
     and p.do_not_contact = false
     and p.status in ('new','researching')
     and not exists (select 1 from public.sequence_enrollments e
                      where e.prospect_id = p.id and e.sequence_id = seq.id)
   order by p.score desc, p.rooms desc nulls last
   limit $1
)
insert into public.sequence_enrollments (prospect_id, sequence_id, current_step, status, next_send_at)
select picked.id, seq.id, 0, 'active', now()
  from picked, seq
returning prospect_id;

nodes.name: Enroll next batch
nodes.notes: dailyCap: set to 10 in warm-up week 1, 20 in week 2, 40 from week 3. Edit the pinned value on the Set node.

meta.description: Feeds the cold email sequence. Picks the highest-ICP-score prospects that have a verified email address and are not already enrolled, and creates an active enrollment due immediately. The SENDER workflow (02) picks them up on its next run.
